column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN package-run-attrs STEP TABLE (CIO-132, designed by the cio 2026-11-11 14:00 CST on officer_05's rung-5 escalation of packages-form-the-run-attributes-of-an-ipl-entry-pin-env-fixtures-alone-have-one-home-and-both-roads-apply-them; cut by officer_05 14:5x CST). THE DESIGN is CIO-132 in GOAL-CIO.md: pin, env, alone, pty, empty and head are ALL.<kind> files at the package root in the ALL.rc form (entry, tab, then the reason, KEY=VALUE or the byte count); STEM.fixtures/ and STEM.shims/ stay beside the program; one reader and one applier in corpus_suite_harness.py, called by both package readers, the per-process road and the builder's cut; the switch defers what it does not apply; util_package_run_attrs.py moves each sidecar to its home and checks it.

# THE NAMES each step must use (chosen by officer_05 under CIO-132, so no step decides one): the reader is _pkg_read_run_attrs(d, entries) in corpus_suite_harness.py; it sets on an Entry pin (str, the reason), env (list of (key, value) in file order, @RUNDIR kept literal), alone (str), pty (str), empty (str), head (int), fixtures_dir (str, the absolute path of STEM.fixtures/) and shims_dir (str, the absolute path of STEM.shims/), each None when absent. The applier is apply_run_attrs(entry, run_dir, env) in corpus_suite_harness.py: it returns (env, cwd), with env a new dict and cwd the directory the entry runs in.

# harness/scripts/test_design_package_run_attrs_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step's PROBE (column 5) from S4E_HOME with a 900 s budget: rc 0 GREEN, rc 1 RED, rc 2 could not measure. Every probe is harness/scripts/s4e_probe_package_run_attrs.sh N; arms 2 to 4 work on a scratch copy of corpus/packages/icon/ipl whose sidecars are turned into root files by the probe itself, never on the live package.
